title: 82% disapprove of Trump. So why are fewer Indian Americans identifying as Democrats?
summary_full: Ahead of the November 3 US midterms, fresh polling shows Indian-Americans strongly favour Democrats on the economy and in congressional races. But a six-year decline in Democratic identification, growing political exhaustion and dissatisfaction with both parties suggest a more complicated relationship with the party.
